evidence.text: Development of a compliance monitoring system for air and water pollution control enforcement housed in MAE.

extra_evidence.text: The project will support the development and deployment of a compliance monitoring system for air and water pollution control enforcement to help the GoL better monitor and enforce environmental protection measures, especially for Category 2 investment projects.18 The system will comprise procedures for monitoring and evaluation (M&E) and reporting of compliance with environmental regulations, a compliance scoring system to track and report performance of Category 2 projects’ environmental obligations, and a system for monitoring fines and penalties.
